name: Daily EU public tender alerts by email (TED)

parameters.content:
## Daily EU tender alerts
Every morning this workflow searches TED (the EU tender journal) with **EU Tender Monitor** on Apify and emails you only **new** tenders that match your keywords, CPV codes and countries.

### Setup (5 minutes)
1. Create a free Apify account and copy your API token (Console → Settings → API & Integrations).
2. In **Find new tenders on TED**, create a *Header Auth* credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`.
3. Edit the JSON body: keywords, CPV codes, countries. Examples: https://apify.com/cognitive_advisory/eu-tender-monitor
4. In **Send email**, set your SMTP credential and the To address.
5. Activate the workflow.

You pay Apify per tender found (about $0.003). Days without new tenders send no email.
